horoscope: While you may want to push ahead with personal plans, dear Aries, you could encounter resistance today as the Moon and Mars oppose one another. As well, Venus and Pluto are heading toward a square, and interactions can be complicated, even loaded at times today. Feelings of unrest may stir, and it would be wise to work through frustrations. You may vacillate between wanting to do things on your own and wanting others involved. There can be clashing wavelengths between you and a friend, or mixed signals in your social life are possible. It can be challenging to pinpoint what other people truly want from you now, but with ambition increasing in comfortable ways, you’re ready to solve problems. If relatively simple problems work you up far more than expected, try to get to the root of the problem.

The Moon spends the day in your responsibility sector, and you're in a productive, goal-oriented frame of mind, dear Taurus. The Moon's aspects tend to surface frustrations that have been simmering beneath the surface, but they may help you address a problem area. Still, watch for doing so impatiently. Emotions and desires can run high, temporarily clouding decision-making. Blockages can frustrate and stir restlessness. It’s not an ideal time to accomplish things cooperatively. Even so, learning that you can handle certain things on your own can be empowering. With Venus retrograde until later January, you may face temporary problems, delays, or emotional freezing around relationships. Today, relationship complications come into sharper focus, but you can approach them differently by seeing them from a new perspective. Keep a safe emotional distance if needed until you gain some perspective. Socially, keep things light. While you’re giving a lot of thought to your career and the path it’s taking, today is about looking back and analyzing. It can be a critical time for reevaluating your projects and goals. You’re likely to gain some new information about an old matter, and while the picture may not yet be complete, you’re one step closer. Aim to be gentle in your communications today.

Today's Moon encourages your lighter, more spontaneous side, dear Gemini, but energies today are complex. Today's Moon-Mars opposition can find you getting worked up with a tense environment, so aim to focus and center yourself as much as possible. Also, retrograde Venus heads toward a square with Pluto, and timing can be off. For example, you may be passionate about something, while others are indifferent, or someone’s trying to gain your attention, and you miss the gesture. Even though events may not unfold as planned today, very little can truly get you down right now, except perhaps routine. However, a lot can be going on beneath the surface, and we tend to express ourselves indirectly, which can be destructive or simply frustrating. An old hurt or resentment can be stirred or triggered. Rather than letting it rule your behavior, examine what's emerging now and try to put it behind you. While entertaining intense emotions is perfectly fine, dwelling on something you don't intend to, or can't, change won't do you any good. It may be difficult, but letting go of a particular stance or desire to be right can be the best thing for you and for your relationships now.

With the Moon in your solar eighth house all day, dear Cancer, you tend to focus on a special project or on an emotional or private matter. However, money, business, or ownership matters can be inflamed just for now. Complicated emotions can interfere with your productivity. Especially as the day advances, it’s possible that somebody close to you is insecure and acting out or bringing up uncomfortable topics. It can be challenging to arrive at an explicit agreement. You may feel an intense attraction, or sense a hidden agenda or emotional traps in some of your interactions. Aim to bring things into the light, at least in your mind, so that you can manage your feelings rather than allow them control your actions.

Mars continues to transit your sign, encouraging your independent, pioneering side, dear Leo, but today's Moon stirs a strong need for companionship. Finding a balance may be challenging, and others might seem to arouse defensiveness in you. However, consider that they may be showing a side of yourself or your unmet needs through your interactions. Especially as the day advances, watch for taking things too personally. Putting the past behind you is not always an easy process. Don't allow fear of change to overrule your day, and avoid going over the same old problems with approaches that didn't work for you in the past. Focus on breaking out of old patterns of relating instead.

The Moon spends today in your work and health sector, dear Virgo, and the desire or need to attend to your duties and routines is in focus. Passions tend to rise even though a good part of you prefers to keep things even and smooth today. As much as you'd like to take care of business and get things in order, the things you haven't done or unsettled matters can interfere. Feeling overwhelmed tends to keep you in limbo, so aim to focus on one thing at a time. It may be best, with a Venus-Pluto square coming into play as the day advances, to tone down your communications, as you may express more intensity than you realize. Even the simplest of communications can feel loaded. Try to examine things if buried frustrations are emerging.

With the Moon in your sector of joy all day, expressing yourself and sharing can be a strong draw, dear Libra. Sensitivity on a social level can lead to quick reactions, however, or hurt feelings, which can heat things up. Getting things out into the open can often be purging, but today's energies tend to encourage sloppy approaches, and you might decide that waiting to address issues is for the best. You may need to rely on others who are not necessarily seeing eye to eye with you. You may be dealing with possessiveness or other emotions that can be a symptom of deeper issues, likely tied to a fear of not being in control. Still, interactions with others may end up revealing hidden desires.

With today's Moon, you can be motivated to bring order or harmony to your home or personal life, dear Scorpio. Certainly, your attention is there. Even so, it might not be easy to get over frustrations, especially if you're feeling pulled in different directions. Allowing the tension to motivate you to make changes or put an irritating situation behind you can be productive. While clearing the air may seem to be what you need, there's a tendency to be too defensive to make much progress, so waiting it out may be best. Not only is the Moon opposed to Mars today, but we're heading to a Venus-Pluto square that complicates interactions. Passions run high today, so that whether you’re feeling love or frustration, they’re magnified. As a result, there can be extra sensitivity and some ups and downs. Seek ways to free yourself of guilt or overcommitment. Avoid letting worry or fear of lack of control spoil your mood.

You can feel especially drawn to your personal interests today, dear Sagittarius, but it's not easy to attend to all your needs and desires. Keep in mind that rushing through your tasks will more than likely lead to mistakes and disagreements with today's Moon-Mars opposition. Aim to first get in touch with your true desires before taking action. Minor tensions are more likely than usual as we also approach a Venus-Pluto square. Dwelling on the past is fruitless, but looking at the past from a different angle can serve you well. You may not see eye to eye with others temporarily, but the tension this creates may result in a new perspective that works in your favor.

Comfort needs assume more importance to you today, dear Capricorn, with the Moon in your solar second house all day. However, as it opposes Mars, tensions can build around boundaries, money, power dynamics, or respect. Attractions can be intense today, but you can also feel unsatisfied if you sense you're out of balance. A Venus-Pluto square in play complicates feelings and interactions further. People may be tempted to stir the pot. New insights into your relationship needs, or a changing attitude towards love, can be emerging now, and it's a process! With complex feelings, if you're not in touch with them, you could behave a little unpredictably. Pick your battles wisely now, or steer clear altogether and choose to explore what's been buried or brushed to the side.

Today's Moon is in your sign all day, dear Aquarius, and your personal needs are in stronger focus. Differences and problem areas are in strong focus, however, and it may not be easy to see around them. You may want to get something off your chest. You are inclined to go your own way, but you also seek acknowledgment from others, which is complicated right now. With an impending Venus-Pluto square, it can be hard to know what's a priority, but taming the desire for drama can help you see the opportunities. You can't control how others approach situations, but you can control how you respond, and sometimes the best response is no response at all! Waiting something out until you have your head straight may be wisest now. Look for desires or feelings you've buried, as they're worth examining.

The Moon spends all day in your privacy sector, dear Pisces, and you need some time to sort through and digest recent experiences. Aim for balance as much as possible today. You can certainly feel torn with the Moon's tense aspects, but getting in touch with true needs and wants should be a priority. Remind yourself that you need some breathing room. As the day advances, we head toward a Venus-Pluto square, and while relationships can improve with more attention given to them, they can be quite vulnerable to pressures to be more than they are. Releasing pent-up anger should be done in ways that don’t eventually bring you or others down. There can be overreaction to little problems and minor events now, but these are symptoms of bigger issues. Be willing to face these issues with self-honesty.
